order_note: No predecessor and no ordering constraint. SQL 123 needs check_intake_items with its deposit and return columns, the check_stage labels 'deposited' and 'returned', checkalt_deposits, check_audit_log and check_billing_events (spec prerequisites; the labels are checked by the file, 42704 sql123_check_stage_label_missing; a read-only production inspect confirms the rest). It works with SQL 120 and SQL 121 when they are live (its trigger fires first on checkalt_deposits; one usage event and one cash-job payment per check either way) and needs neither. Adds one public trigger (aws_checkalt_deposit_apply_check_status): the DB validator's justified set and expected count follow once this file is applied, as #1309 did for SQL 120, not before. The one-time move touches only checks the inspect counts as checkalt_approved_checks_to_move.
